title: Magic Mall/Marketplace/Library
content: I’ve been having vivid dreams lately and last night I had one about a big building…I had gotten there through some kind of magic but I can’t remember what I did exactly. I first walked in through a food court and stopped to get some food. I remember they had malasadas, so I got that and a bunch of other stuff and gathered it all in my arms to sit and eat. Afterwards, I kept walking down the hall. There was a guy next to me, flirting with me. I usually don’t have dreams where I interact with strangers, usually it’s people I know. I said something like, “I’m gonna guess you’re like 20?” and he blushed and left me alone. I then entered this big open atrium with glass ceilings. This was the library part, and there were a bunch of high shelves and colourful books, most of which I had never seen before. There was something special about the books, I can’t quite put my finger on why now. Eventually I went off through some side door and entered a sort of cramped hallway, which led me to a marketplace. It more so looked like a cramped vintage store, with soft lights, dark wood paneling on the walls, random furniture, but I thought of it as a marketplace. There were all these wonderful things, like felt animals, these really gorgeous leather wallets, greeting cards and journals (though I remember one of the planners specifically was for 2011 lol), cat toys. I remember spending a long time trying to decide if I wanted to bring home these two very cute fish themed cat wand toys for my cat. All these items by the way are things I would enjoy, so maybe to other people that’s not that exciting. However, the more I browsed the more I got this sense that it was a trap, that I shouldn’t try to buy anything, that the place was coming up with more things I would like to keep me there. Eventually I tried to leave, and a shopkeeper (that up until then I hadn’t seen) got mad at me. I found my way to my car (which I did not get out of at the start of the dream) and through some kind of struggle got into it and drove away. It’s not very clear to me anymore but that’s around when I woke up.
